SpaXio - Visium HD Spatial Transcriptomics Training

Amandine Sandri (MAL Team), Ghislain Bidaut (CRCM Cibi Platform), Michel Aurrand-lions

Centre de Recherche en Cancérologie de Marseille




During this training, we will implement a spatial transcriptomics pipeline to analyze a leukemic bone marrow sample provided by Michel Aurrand-lions’s team.

Learning objectives: Practice of spatial analysis

Trainers: Amandine / Ghislain

  1. Loupe Browser Exploration, with a dedicated protocol: explore the Visium slide and draw a region of interest (ROI)

  2. Segmentation, Python notebook (Bin2cell / StarDist): testing segmentation parameters on the previously drawn region to show the main steps

  3. Single-cell analysis up to annotation, RStudio (Seurat): QC, clustering, annotation and visualization of the segmented cells on the whole slide

  4. Loupe Browser Annotation, with a dedicated protocol : Explore the slide with annotations from step 3

Optional:

  • Spatial analysis of the annotated object, Python notebook (Squidpy): neighbourhood, distances, megakaryocyte merging

  • Annotation and Loupe Browser visualization:

    1. Run script to subset spatial object to region of interest

    2. Run script to export the annotation as CSV
